rationale: The assistant raised the electrical hazard in the first turn and suggested switching off at the consumer unit. In turn two it spotted the foam from the 'loads of bubbles' and asked about detergent, which was correct. Weaknesses: the first reply wrongly led with a door seal diagnosis, and its numbering was garbled. When the customer said they would turn it off at the wall, the assistant never clearly said to use the consumer unit instead of reaching near wet floor and an extension lead. The last reply also told the customer to plug the machine back in once the area is dry, without telling them to use only dishwasher detergent, run rinse cycles or inform the landlord. The electrician referral was appropriately cautious, though slightly over-firm.
